_comment: sim-host-fault-controlled-stop-v1 bounded GPU acceptance. The fix is DEFAULT-ON and inert on success (it activates only on a manipulation failure while a carton is welded), so there is NO runtime-config key to merge -- this fragment is the acceptance recipe for the integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1), scheduled through /tmp/aile-gpu.lock; never run from the worker lane. Goal: force a carried-carton guard trip at the WELDED place and prove the controlled stop keeps the base planted, keeps the carton held, and names the first trip -- instead of the coldwin33 fling + 'arm command heartbeat lost'.
_how_to_force_the_trip: The captain-fixed 2.0 deg carton-level bound trips naturally at a marginal set-down (coldwin33 tripped at 2.06 deg at the collect place). Two bounded ways to reproduce a WELDED-place guard trip: (A) re-run the coldwin33 side-bay cold cycle (orchestrate-coldwin33.sh / mission-runtime-coldwin33.json) -- the same set-down tilt recurs; (B) a `start_at=transfer` bench (RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose, RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard,weld) reaches the far-extended dock place quickly, the other place where a guard trips while welded. Either reaches a CARTON_TILT trip with the carton welded + the arm extended over the deck.
_do_not_change: Do NOT loosen the carton-level bound (2.0 deg) or grace (0.15 s) -- they are captain-fixed. The set-down tilt itself is a separate lane. This run proves only the POST-trip behaviour.

_assert_pass.controlled_stop_engaged: orch-console.log / host-stack.log shows 'WELDED_CONTROLLED_STOP engaged: base full-braked, arm held energised, weld kept (reason=...CARTON_TILT...)' at the trip, and 'CONTROLLED_STOP_BAND nominal roll ... pitch ... z ...' once at the first stage start.
_assert_pass.base_stays_planted: every BASE_ATT line AFTER the trip stays inside the band: roll within ~20 deg of nominal (~0 deg), pitch within ~20 deg of nominal (~-1.2 deg), z within 0.15 m of nominal (~0.24 m). NO roll/pitch blow-up (coldwin33 reached roll 138, pitch 47, z 2.11) and NO 'MOBILE_BRAKE released' + BASE_FULL_BRAKE engage/release thrash during the stop.
_assert_pass.carton_held: the carton is not flung: the weld stays (no gripper-open / no carton launched off the deck); COLLECT_GT/TRANSFER_CAPTURE held=True through the stop.
_assert_pass.no_rebegin_drive: collect/transfer does NOT re-begin on a flipped base -- no second 'stage_begin attempt 2' nav drive after the welded trip (StageRetry aborts on the welded controlled-stop gate).
_assert_pass.named_reason: mission.json 'reason' and the terminal stage_failed name the FIRST trip ('host emergency stop (host fault: CARTON_TILT carried carton off level: ... 2.06 deg)'), NEVER the downstream 'arm command heartbeat lost'.

_assert_fail: A roll/pitch/z outside the band after the trip, a carton launched off the deck, any 'arm command heartbeat lost' terminal reason, or a collect/transfer re-begin after the welded trip = the controlled stop did not hold.
_notes: No config key and no env var is required for the fix. The run config is whatever reproduces the welded-place trip (e.g. the coldwin33 config). The only new always-on log lines are CONTROLLED_STOP_BAND (once) and WELDED_CONTROLLED_STOP (on the trip); a successful run that never trips a welded fault is behaviourally byte-identical.
